packageRules.description: The Paper the server runs. A new Minecraft version means moving the whole server, so it's tracked by .github/workflows/minecraft.yml, not Renovate.
Third-party actions run with the repo's secrets, so they're pinned to a commit (CodeQL flags tags, which can be moved); Renovate keeps the pins current. GitHub's own actions stay on tags.

CI builds, tests and boots everything, so small updates merge themselves once it passes. Merging rebuilds the server release, but nothing reaches the live server until it's reinstalled. Majors wait for a review.
